title: CBSE declares KVS & NVS Tier-II results for Primary Teachers (PRT) and Junior Secretariat Assistants
titleHi: CBSE ने KVS व NVS के प्राथमिक शिक्षक (PRT) एवं कनिष्ठ सचिवालय सहायक पद के टियर-II परिणाम घोषित किए
summary: Under Recruitment Notification 01/2025, CBSE's CTET Unit declared Tier-II results for PRT and JSA posts on 14 September 2026. For posts with an interview, the result indicates shortlisting status for the interview; schedules and call letters will be issued via candidate logins after finalisation with KVS/NVS.
whyItMatters: Directly relevant to KVS PRT aspirants — the interview stage is next. Also a likely 'education/recruitment' current-affairs point.

mcq.text: Which body is conducting the KVS & NVS Recruitment Examination 2025 (Notification 01/2025), whose PRT Tier-II results were declared on 14 September 2026?

options.whyIncorrect: UPSC conducts civil services and some central recruitments, not this one.
NTA conducts NEET, JEE, UGC-NET etc.

mcq.explanation: The Central Board of Secondary Education's CTET Unit is conducting the KVS/NVS recruitment under Rectt. Notification 01/2025; press releases are issued by the Director (CTET).

title: UPESSC publishes structure of UP Primary Assistant Teacher (Class 1–5) Recruitment Exam 2026: 120 MCQs, 3 marks each, negative marking
titleHi: UPESSC ने प्राथमिक विद्यालय सहायक अध्यापक भर्ती परीक्षा 2026 की संरचना प्रकाशित की: 120 प्रश्न, 3 अंक प्रत्येक, ऋणात्मक अंकन
summary: The official syllabus document from the Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission specifies: 120 minutes, 120 MCQs, 3 marks per question, 1 mark deducted per wrong answer, bilingual (Hindi/English) paper. Subjects: GK/Current Events 25, Reasoning 5, Hindi-Sanskrit-English 30, Science 8, Maths 16, EVS & Social Studies 8, Teaching Skill 8, Child Psychology 8, IT 4, Life Skills/Management & Attitude 8.
whyItMatters: This is the exam this app prepares you for. Note the change from earlier 'Super TET' pattern discussions — negative marking of 1 mark per wrong answer is significant for strategy.

mcq.text: As per the UPESSC syllabus for the Primary Assistant Teacher Recruitment Exam 2026, how many marks are deducted for each wrong answer?

options.whyIncorrect: The document explicitly mentions negative marking.

mcq.explanation: The official document states: 'गलत उत्तर दिये जाने पर 01 अंक घटा दिया जायेगा' — each question carries 3 marks and 1 mark is deducted per wrong answer.

title: President confers National Teachers' Awards 2026 on 48 teachers on Teachers' Day
titleHi: राष्ट्रपति ने शिक्षक दिवस पर 48 शिक्षकों को राष्ट्रीय शिक्षक पुरस्कार 2026 प्रदान किए
summary: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the National Teachers' Awards 2026 on 48 school teachers at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi (26 men, 22 women from 27 states, 7 UTs and 6 central organisations), as reported.
whyItMatters: Teachers' Day (5 September, birth anniversary of Dr S. Radhakrishnan) and the National Teachers' Awards are classic GK items; also a good talking point in the KVS interview.

mcq.text: National Teachers' Day in India (5 September) marks the birth anniversary of:

options.whyIncorrect: Kalam's birthday, 15 October, is World Students' Day.
His birthday, 11 November, is National Education Day.
Her birthday, 3 January, is observed as Balika Din in Maharashtra.

mcq.explanation: Dr Radhakrishnan (b. 5 Sept 1888), philosopher-teacher and second President of India. World Teachers' Day is 5 October (UNESCO).

title: 18 September — International Equal Pay Day and World Bamboo Day
titleHi: 18 सितंबर — अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समान वेतन दिवस एवं विश्व बाँस दिवस
summary: International Equal Pay Day (UN, first observed 2020) highlights the gender pay gap. World Bamboo Day was declared by the World Bamboo Organization in 2009. Other September days: 5 Teachers' Day; 8 International Literacy Day; 14 Hindi Diwas; 15 Engineers' Day & International Day of Democracy; 16 World Ozone Day; 17 World Patient Safety Day; 21 International Day of Peace; 27 World Tourism Day.
whyItMatters: Important days are a guaranteed 1–2 questions in the GK section.

mcq.text: World Ozone Day is observed on 16 September to commemorate the signing of which protocol?

options.whyIncorrect: Paris (2015) is a climate agreement, not a protocol on ozone.

mcq.explanation: The Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer was signed on 16 September 1987; the UN designated the day in 1994.

title: Hindi Diwas 2026 marks 77 years of Hindi's adoption as the official language of the Union
titleHi: हिंदी दिवस 2026: संघ की राजभाषा के रूप में हिंदी को अपनाने के 77 वर्ष
summary: On 14 September 1949 the Constituent Assembly adopted Hindi in Devanagari script as the official language of the Union (Article 343). Hindi Diwas has been observed since 1953.
whyItMatters: Constitution + important day + language — three syllabus areas in one item.
